title: Representable surjective etale scheme maps give fppf local lifts
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. For an $S$-scheme $W$, write $h_W(T)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(T,W)$. Let $U$ be an $S$-scheme and $p:h_U\to F$ a representable surjective etale morphism in the scheme-test sense of [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For every $S$-scheme $T$ and every $\xi\in F(T)$, the sheaf pullback $h_T\times_{\xi,F,p}h_U$ is represented by an $S$-scheme $V$ with projections $v:V\to T$ and $a:V\to U$ satisfying $p_V(a)=F(v)(\xi)$. The morphism $v$ is surjective etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and the singleton $\{v:V\to T\}$ is an fppf covering. Thus $p$ is locally surjective as a map of sheaves of sets: each section of $F$ has a lift to $h_U$ on a covering. Consequently $p$ is an epimorphism in the category of fppf sheaves of sets. No algebraic-space hypothesis on $F$ or global lift of $\xi$ to $U(T)$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0262 (lemma-space-presentation), proof of (3), construction V = T times_F U; Topologies Tag 021M (definition-fppf-covering) in topologies.tex; Sites Tags 00WM (definition-sheaves-injective-surjective) and 00WN (lemma-mono-epi-sheaves) in sites.tex. The construction does not use a representable diagonal of F.

proof.text: Fix an $S$-scheme $T$ and $\xi\in F(T)$. Define $\widehat\xi:h_T\to F$ on $b:W\to T$ by $\widehat\xi_W(b)=F(b)(\xi)$; functoriality of $F$ gives naturality. Apply the scheme-test definition in [def-trf-algebraic-space] to $p$ and $\widehat\xi$. It supplies a representing scheme $V$ for $h_T\times_F h_U$, and the projection $v:V\to T$ is surjective etale by the assumed scheme-test properties of $p$. More explicitly, the representing isomorphism sends $\mathrm{id}_V$ to a pair $(v,a)$, where $a:V\to U$ is an $S$-morphism and $p_V(a)=\widehat\xi_V(v)=F(v)(\xi)$ by the defining equality of the fibre product. Naturality shows that $b:W\to V$ is sent to $(v\circ b,a\circ b)$, so these are precisely its two projections.

source.place: Tag 0262, lemma-space-presentation, proof of (3): form V = T times_{xi,F,f} U; scheme-test representability supplies V and its surjective etale projection.

proof.text: By [def-weil-etale-morphism], the etale morphism $v$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Its surjectivity says $T=v(V)$, including when $T$ is empty. Thus the singleton family $\{v:V\to T\}$ meets every covering condition of [def-pc-fppf-site] and is an fppf covering. Only local finite presentation is required; no quasi-compactness or global finite presentation is used.

source.place: Tag 021M, definition-fppf-covering: flat, locally of finite presentation and jointly surjective; applied to the surjective etale projection of Tag 0262.

proof.text: The equality $p_V(a)=F(v)(\xi)$ from step 1 says exactly that the restriction of $\xi$ to $V$ lifts to the section $a\in h_U(V)$. Step 2 gives a covering on which this lift exists. Since $T$ and $\xi$ were arbitrary, every section of $F$ locally lies in the image of $p$: this is local surjectivity in the covering-family sense.

source.place: Tag 00WM, definition-sheaves-injective-surjective, part (2); the covering and lift constructed in Tag 0262, proof of (3).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-epi-locally-surjective] to the big fppf site and the morphism of sheaves of sets $p:h_U\to F$. Step 3 verifies exactly its covering-family local-surjectivity condition. Hence $p$ is an epimorphism of fppf sheaves of sets. All constructions used only the scheme-test properties of $p$; no representability of the diagonal of $F$ was invoked.

source.place: Tag 00WN, lemma-mono-epi-sheaves: surjective maps of sheaves of sets are epimorphisms.
